Thanks for looping me in. Finance is okay with a conservative approach if we limit revenue exposure. Proposed options: 

Option A (minimal risk)
- Temp uplift priced at list for the extra capacity (no discount)
- Overrun invoiced at month-end with a cap of no more than 150% of committed monthly spend (as Irene suggested)
- Any short-term commit converts to a partial credit applied to the following month’s invoice

Option B (sales-favorable)
- 10% discount on uplift fee if customer signs a 3-month amortized addendum for the uplift value 
- One-time courtesy credit equal to 5% of the uplift charge for this event (to be applied in next invoice)

Need legal to approve the one-page amendment wording for the cap clause, and need a quick internal signoff for a one-time credit. If legal is slow, we can do the uplift first under a verbal agreement and attach the amendment when signed, but I’d rather have the doc in place.
